_README: The training charter (#5068, epic #5067): the ONE source of every training target the engine, the critics, the coaches and the skills read. HAND-OWNED (deploy/config_ownership_audit.py); any change needs an owner ruling and a change_log entry. This file is PUBLIC. The owner-only twin (body/appearance targets) is never committed — see config/training_charter.private.example.json and lambdas/training/training_charter.py. Published surfaces read ONLY training_charter.public_view() (the PUBLISHED_WHITELIST); the target date and the rate band are not on it (owner ruling 2026-10-18: no May countdown or May target on the site). ADR-164.

change_log.what: First charter: the frame, the rate band, the 5-day split, the step floor and target, the cardio menu, no scheduled deload, effort ceilings, rotation cadence, gated movements, the concession ledger.
change_log.rule: any change needs an owner ruling; bump `version` and add a line here

The redline copy is retired; the engine reads it here.

change_log.what: Renames effort_ceilings.by_experience_tier to by_movement_class (it always held the two movement-class bands, not tiers) holding exactly the ruled bands, and states that a set is graded against the HIGH end of its class band (effort_ceilings.ceiling_is; progression.ceiling_tier read the low end until #5058). The tolerance and the proposal rule are the ruled ones, unchanged in value.

change_log.by: owner ruling 2026-10-18 (second round, #5090): running is in the May plan; cleared with no exercise restrictions; effort by RPE / talk test
change_log.what: Builds the run gate's missing Stage 4. gated_movements.running gains the walking condition as numbers (4 consecutive weeks of >= 8.5 h weight-bearing walking, each without a lower-leg pain flag — the owner_redlines run_gate_lb tissue clause, now read here), the reading (the gate opens the run/walk on-ramp; continuous running is unlocked when the on-ramp is completed) and the on-ramp itself: treadmill first, eight levels from 1 min run / 2 min walk to 30 min continuous, two sessions at a level at or under the easy block's RPE with no pain flag to advance, max 2 runs a week, none on a heavy lower day or the session either side of it; a lower-leg strain flag pauses the run/walk (as it pauses the pogo hops) and holds the on-ramp at its level; the Stage 4 record is read back to history_from (the ruling day). lower_leg_prep gains its prescription (calf work, tibialis work, low-amplitude pogo hops on lower days from the prep weight; brisk incline walking is the menu's default block) and the catalog keys of the carve-out — the ONLY plyometric keys the generator may place; every other plyometric entry stays excluded. cardio_menu.blocks gains run_walk (placed by training.run_onramp once the gate is open, never by the weekly menu rule). The level table, the prep doses and the spacing rule's sequence reading are platform-chosen within the ruling.

Read by health.calorie_target.resolve (day_type seam) and printed in the plan's training_day_fuel block.

change_log.by: owner direction 2026-10-18 on the nutrition elite-panel review (#5096, epic #5091: the redlines' titration rule gets a reader); weekly refit built on the panel default, pending R1
change_log.what: nutrition.titration: the weekly titration engine's rule (lambdas/health/titration.py), MOVED here from nutrition.calories.titration (same rule values: 150 kcal step, 14-day spacing, never on a week with fewer than 6 complete logs, not before day 21, two consecutive out-of-band reads, steps before food) and nutrition.calories.titration_record. The band it reads is the charter rate band (governing_goal.rate_band_lb_per_wk through training.rate_band, the clinical guidance cap applied) above the landing, and the redlines' own landing schedule step (target to cap) from the landing down: the redlines' old 'target +/- 0.5 lb/wk' band is retired, so one band governs both the rate target and the titration. The step is sized from the miss (500 kcal/day per lb/wk, 3500 kcal per lb over 7 days), rounded to 50 and held inside min_step_kcal..max_step_kcal. owner_redlines energy_floor_kcal.titration reads this block (max_step_kcal is the one step-size key; the old step_kcal duplicate is dropped). Every rule value is required: a missing one holds the week as insufficient_data, never a fallback. trend_days must equal the shared loss-rate window. A complete log is a day at or above the redlines' dark-day line, and the first step waits for the redlines' complete_days_before_first_titration (both read from owner_redlines, not copied). The redlines' owner rule 'walking FIRST, then food, never both inside 14 days' is kept as a walking-first hold; the steps-floor precondition on top of it is the panel interpretation, pending an owner ruling on epic #5091. The modelled `expected_path` moves with the block; `insufficient_loss_with_logging_intact` is carried by the walking_first rule and the redlines tripwire loss_insufficient_adherent.

governing_goal.mentality: time-bound, must-hit: every expert school is synthesized and each concedes something to the deadline (see concession_ledger)

rate_band_lb_per_wk.note: always shown in lb AND as a percent of bodyweight

governing_goal.precedence: the owner clinical guidance record (USER#matthew#SOURCE#clinical, GUIDANCE#current) outranks the rate band wherever the two conflict; it is reference context, never a gate on intensity

phase_after_may.frame: toward the long-term goal and maintenance — the frame does not end at the target date
phase_after_may.rule: the charter is re-versioned on an owner ruling before the target date, not after it

minimum_session.shape: anchors only, top set + one back-off
minimum_session.from: owner_redlines lifting_sessions_per_wk.minimum_viable_session, tightened to 20 minutes for disruption weeks (#5088)

split.rule: the next session is the one after the last performed lift, whatever the date

ramp.held_by: a lower-leg strain flag holds the ramp at its current level

steps.note: walking carries the volume; gym cardio is deliberate, from the menu

cardio_menu.progression: same RPE at a higher level

intervals.note: RPE 8 on the hard minutes; open by RPE / talk test
intervals.talk_test: a few words on the hard minutes

run_walk.talk_test: full sentences on the walk, short phrases on the run
run_walk.placed_by: training.run_onramp once the run gate is open: an easy slot only, never a conditioning slot

placement.rule: conditioning 2x/wk (one tempo-or-hills, one intervals), every other block easy; the recumbent after a lower day or a heavy walking weekend; never the same hard shape on consecutive days

cardio_menu.movement_minutes: gym cardio minutes count toward the daily steps/movement goal (steps.gym_cardio_minutes_count_toward_movement)

deload.note: fatigue signals become a recommendation; a deload happens only on his recorded word (owner ruling 2026-10-18)

effort_ceilings.ceiling_is: the high end of the set's class band: the band is the prescription, its top is the ceiling a set is graded against
effort_ceilings.overage_rule: within +1 RPE of the ceiling is not a breach

ceiling_change_proposal.when: a ceiling is beaten on more than 50% of sets two weeks running
ceiling_change_proposal.effect: proposes a ceiling change (an owner ruling applies it)

gain_rule.trigger: the top of the slot's rep range on the top set of 2 consecutive same-type exposures (heavy -> heavy, volume -> volume), each logged at or under the movement's effort ceiling
gain_rule.size: +2.5 % of the load in whole 5-lb steps, never less than one 5-lb step; reps back to the bottom of the range
gain_rule.rpe_role: veto only — a top-of-range set logged above the movement's effort ceiling (or with no RPE logged) does not count toward the trigger
refused_when: the week after a rate-over-cap flag
the first three exposures of a novel-again pattern

self_raised_load.rule: a load the owner raised himself, logged at or under the movement's effort ceiling (an overage within `effort_ceilings.overage_tolerance_rpe` is not a breach), becomes the next floor and is graded `progressed` — a named state, never folded into an adherence percentage
self_raised_load.above_the_ceiling: a raised load logged above the ceiling plus the tolerance is a breach and never becomes a floor

ceiling_tier.last_isolation_set: the high end of `effort_ceilings.by_movement_class.last_isolation_set_rpe`; an isolation movement's earlier sets read the compounds band

stall_rule.rpe_basis: self-reported: the RPE he logged on the top set (the first working set at the session's heaviest load); an unlogged RPE is not evidence
stall_rule.trigger: the top set's load and reps are identical on the last 3 consecutive same-type exposures, each logged at RPE 8 or lower
stall_rule.step: below the top of the slot's rep range: up to `rep_step_max` more reps at the same load, never past the top; at the top of the range (or with no range on file): the gain rule's load step (`gain_rule.step_pct` in whole `gain_rule.step_lb` steps), reps back to the bottom
stall_rule.not_a_stall: step_due is the prescription's failure to progress, not his: it never fires when he fell short of a prescription on file, and it never fires under a refusal (re-entry, a deload the owner applied)
stall_rule.precedence: after the gain rule's step; before a floor raise (repeating the same load is what it ends)

prerequisites: Stage 4 of the run/walk on-ramp completed
running.walking_basis: weight-bearing walking hours (training.walking_volume, the walking modality: Strava walks/hikes plus Hevy treadmill/walking blocks, de-duplicated), consecutive completed weeks, each without a lower-leg pain flag
running.reading: at or under the gate weight with the walking weeks met, the gate OPENS the run/walk on-ramp (Stage 4); continuous running is unlocked when Stage 4 is completed (onramp.complete_when)

advance_rule.rule: two sessions at a level, each logged at or under the easy block's top RPE and with no lower-leg pain flag, advance one level; an unlogged RPE is not evidence

onramp.complete_when: the last level completed twice under the advance rule
onramp.spacing_rule: no run on a heavy lower day, nor on the session before or after it in split.sequence (day-level reading of 24 h)
onramp.held_by: a lower-leg strain flag (training.steps_ramp: a strain flag or an active standing constraint) pauses the run/walk — no run is placed, the same impact rule that pauses the pogo hops — and holds the on-ramp at its level: no session dated on or after the flag counts, and the level earned before it is kept
onramp.history_from_why: the owner's ruling that put running in the plan: no on-ramp session exists before it, so a Stage 4 reader reads back to this day and an early level never ages out of a rolling window
onramp.counts_toward_movement: run/walk minutes count toward the daily movement goal (steps.gym_cardio_minutes_count_toward_movement)
onramp.provenance: owner ruling 2026-10-18 (running in the May plan, by RPE / talk test); the level table and the spacing reading are platform-chosen

prescription.cue: toes-up raises, back to a wall
ankle-only bounce, heels barely leave the floor; stop on any shin or heel pain

lower_leg_prep.incline_walking: the menu's default block (cardio_menu.blocks.incline_treadmill_walk) is the brisk incline walking
lower_leg_prep.placement: lower days (the split.sequence names opening 'lower'), after the lifting
lower_leg_prep.held_by: a lower-leg strain flag holds the pogo hops (the calf and tibialis work stay)
lower_leg_prep.note: the carve-out is limited to the list; everything else plyometric stays excluded

equipment.assumed: full commercial club — machines, cables, plate-loaded, T-bar, dumbbells to heavy, kettlebells, sled, full cardio deck
equipment.rule: the club is never named in this repo

travel.rule: travel templates by mid-December; no calendar blocking

disruption.rule: the owner switches the mode on and off; the coach OFFERS it and never applies it (owner ruling 2026-10-18, #5088)

travel.note: a resort/hotel gym first, bodyweight when there is none

busy.note: the 20-minute minimum at the usual club

step_back_up.serves: the minimum session at the club

fitness_tests.aligned_to: the block: a battery is due in the program week that closes each block (program week a whole multiple of every_weeks)
fitness_tests.dead_man: a due week passed with no battery is overdue for grace_weeks, then missed; missed is the dead-man state

test_day.session: the role's minimum session (split.minimum_session) plus the tests in `order`
test_day.why: the lightest day of the split carries the tests, so no heavy leg work blunts the walk or the bike

six_minute_walk.label: 6-minute walk
six_minute_walk.protocol: Treadmill at 0 % incline, no handrails, no running: the fastest steady walk you can hold for 6 minutes. Log the distance.
six_minute_walk.hevy: a Treadmill set of about 6 minutes with a distance

bike_20min_rpe6.label: 20-minute bike at RPE 6
bike_20min_rpe6.protocol: The same bike every time (note which). 20 minutes held at RPE 6, short sentences only. Log the distance.
bike_20min_rpe6.hevy: a Cycling set of about 20 minutes with a distance

dead_hang.label: dead hang
dead_hang.protocol: Overhand grip, shoulder width, feet off the floor, one attempt until the grip goes. Log the seconds.

assisted_pull_up.label: assisted pull-up assistance
assisted_pull_up.protocol: Assisted pull-up machine: the least assistance at which 5 clean reps (full hang, chin over the bar) complete. Start at the last test's assistance. Log the assistance.
assisted_pull_up.hevy: the least assistance on a Pull Up (Assisted) set of at least 5 reps

fitness_tests.provenance: the battery and its cadence: owner direction 2026-10-18 (#5078); the protocol detail (units, machines, order, test day): platform-proposed for the owner's review

nippard.concedes: a faster deficit than it would pick

rp_israetel.concedes: no scheduled deload and legs at maintenance
rp_israetel.in_return: rising volume on shoulders, lats and upper chest plus MEV floors

sbs_nuckols.in_return: coded progression and strength tracking that catches muscle loss early

galpin.in_return: weekly fatigue flags and a real hard/easy cardio split

dan_john.concedes: machines and isolation in the mix

hollywood_transformation_trainer.in_return: gets the frame, the deadline, the steps and the session length

clinical_exercise_physiologist.in_return: weekly strength, sleep and fat-free-mass tracking, effort by RPE

panel_target.rule: every seat scores at least 9/10 with its concession named

calories.reading: target_kcal is the day's calorie target (panel default R1: eat up to the prescribed band now). A titration record for the week outranks it; the any-day floor clamps any resolved value. The lifting-day and any-day floors grade single days; the 7-day-mean floor is reported, not enforced.
calories.derived_by: red-team consensus 2026-09-22 (physician + nutritionist floors; the calibrated model's 'highest intake that reproduces the trajectory')

expenditure.against: scale-trend-implied expenditure: mean logged intake over the shared 14-day loss-rate window + 3500 kcal per lb of that rate, per day

protein.range_note: low is the plan's floor (config/user_goals.json targets.nutrition.daily_protein_min_g, generated into common.constants.PLAN_DAILY_PROTEIN_MIN_G; a contract test holds the three equal); high is the target the redlines name
protein.hit: a day is a hit when its logged total is at or above range_g.low, strictly: no tolerance below the floor until the owner rules one (#5003). An unlogged day is unknown, never a miss
protein.feeding_rule: food-log rows within feeding_merge_minutes of a feeding's first row are one feeding; a feeding counts when its protein is at or above feeding_threshold_g. A day with no timed rows has an unknown feeding count, never 0
protein.fasting_window: relaxed (panel default, pending R2): an early first feeding is wanted, not a breach; the eating-window field itself is the calorie-band lane's

breakfast_nudge.channel: owner email on the coach-nudge hourly tick
breakfast_nudge.rule: behind when no feeding at or above feeding_threshold_g is logged at or before the later of the cut-off and the tick; no food-log row for the day withholds the note (no_same_day_log): the food log is an end-of-day upload, so an absent row at breakfast is upload lag, not a missed feeding; untimed rows withhold the note (unknown). Armed but silent until a same-day food source exists (#5187)

protein.basis: built on the panel default, pending R2 (#5091)

titration.read: the shared 14-day least-squares loss rate (mcp.shared_quantities.loss_rate_lb_wk, water weeks excluded), read weekly
titration.trend_days_rule: must equal mcp.shared_quantities.LOSS_RATE_WINDOW_DAYS (the window the trend is read over); on a mismatch the run withholds the trend and the week holds (trend_window_mismatch), and tests/test_titration_engine_5096.py asserts they agree
titration.act_on: consecutive_out_of_band_reads weekly reads on the same side of the band
titration.step_sizing: the miss (lb/wk outside the band edge) x kcal_per_lb_wk, rounded to step_rounding_kcal, held inside min_step_kcal..max_step_kcal

steps_before_food.rule: below the band floor, food comes down only when the trailing steps mean is at or above steps.floor; otherwise the week holds and the cue is the steps floor. This precondition is added ON TOP of walking_first, built on the panel interpretation, pending an owner ruling (#5091)

walking_first.rule: the redlines' owner rule (feet before fork): below the floor with steps at the floor, the first confirmed read is a walking-first hold (the cue is the rule's walking action); food comes down only on a later read at least min_days_between_steps after it, with the run unbroken (never both inside the spacing)

complete_logs.rule: a complete day is one whose logged calories are at or above the redlines' dark-day line (a day under it is dark, not complete); the first step also waits for the redlines' run of complete days before the first titration

band_source.above_landing: governing_goal.rate_band_lb_per_wk (training.rate_band.band, the clinical guidance cap applied)
band_source.from_landing_down: owner_redlines rate_schedule_lb_wk step at the bodyweight (training.redline_rate.rate_schedule_step): target to cap

titration.expected_path: 2,100 to 275 → 2,000 to 240 → 1,950 to 220 → rising to 2,000–2,150 through the landing → ~2,700–2,800 at maintenance (model; measure RMR)
titration.insufficient_data: no measured trend, a provisional trend window, no weigh-in, an unreadable band or guidance record, an unreadable rule value, or too few complete logs: the week holds with reason insufficient_data, never a guess

record.writer: lambdas/health/titration.py via mcp/titration_leg.py on the nightly pre-draft run (Friday to Sunday nights, the first write for the coming week stands)

dead_man.rule: no record for the current week once armed: an owner-only alert (the calibration sweep's dead-man, token NUTRITION_TITRATION_MISSED)

titration.basis: the redlines' titration rule, owner-approved v0.3 (#3753); the weekly refit built on the panel default, pending R1 (#5091)

training_day.balance: the week averages the base target: a rest day takes -(uplift x lifting days / rest days) so the uplift is paid for inside the week (5 lifting / 2 rest: -375); travel and unknown days stay at the base. A day clamped by its floor is reported balance_held false
training_day.split_rule: protein = nutrition.protein.range_g.low and fat = fat_pct of the base target, both held every day; the uplift and the offset are carbohydrate

post_session.note: the post-session protein is one of the four feedings (nutrition.protein.feeding_threshold_g)

training_day.travel_day: no uplift and no rest-day offset: the base target holds; pre and post targets still apply when a session is done
training_day.day_type: lifting | rest | travel | unknown: travel from a travel disruption or charter travel window; else lifting/rest from the planned routine for the date; else unknown (base target, never a guessed rest day: the split sequence has no calendar, so the plan states the lifting uplift and the rest offset as conditional until a per-date calendar exists)
training_day.surface: owner-only: the plan_next_session constraint block (training_day_fuel) and the coach packet; no public surface
training_day.basis: built on the panel default, pending R1 (#5091)

floors.hit: a day meets a floor when its logged total is at or above it, strictly. A missing field is unknown, never a miss (health.macro_floors)
floors.grade_weight: the three floors share the nutrition component's macro-split slot (0.20); calories 0.40 and protein 0.40 are untouched (docs/engines/SCORING.md)
floors.derived_by: red-team consensus 2026-09-22 (nutritionist, physician and S&C coach); moved from owner_redlines.py by #5102

evidence_based_hypertrophy_nutrition.concedes: a deeper deficit than a muscle-first cut would pick
evidence_based_hypertrophy_nutrition.in_return: the protein range every day, the fat and carbohydrate floors held, training-day fuel

protein_lean_mass.concedes: protein counted from a log, not a weighed meal plan
protein_lean_mass.in_return: four feedings at the per-feeding threshold, the post-session protein counted as one

appetite_food_environment.concedes: a calorie target instead of a food-quality-only approach
appetite_food_environment.in_return: the fibre floor, a fixed feeding rhythm and no day under its floor

energy_balance_metabolism.in_return: a weekly refit against the measured trend in small, bounded steps
